newsitem.title: USA: Pharmaceutical Product Oct revs $17.7 mln.
newsitem.headline: Pharmaceutical Product Oct revs $17.7 mln.

text.p: Pharmaceutical Product Development Inc said that in October, its first month as a combined company, it earned $994,000 or $0.05 per share, on revenues of $17.7 million.
Pharmaceutical Product Development Inc merged with Applied Biosciences International Inc on September 26.
The company said given its results so far, it was mystified by the recent decline in its share price.
The shares were trading at 17-3/4, up 3/4 from the close but down from a year high of 47-3/4.

"We are pleased with our first full month as a combined company," Chief Executive Officer Fred Eshelman said. "October results were in line with analysts' projections for a full fourth quarter, and, hopefully, indicative of our progress going forward."
In October, there were 21.6 million shares outstanding.
The company filed an 8-K to disclose its October results.
